body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics presented HSDPA phone ''SPH-W2100'' during KES 2006. The SPH-W2100 on the Korea market through KTF is a semi-automatic slide design phone. Its 2.12-inch QVGA (240x320) LCD allows you to enjoy video call or DMB play. Other features include T-DMB, 2M camera with auto-focus, MP3P, IrDA, microSD(TransFlash) external memory slot, TV out and so on.
